nodes.title: astralwaveorg/AgentRelayNext
nodes.description: Agent Relay: local-first macOS where one AI coding agent implements in an isolated Git worktree, another independent model reviews read-only, and you get a patch, test receipt, and review evidence. Claude Code + OpenCode + MCP, MIT. | Agent Relay：本地优先 macOS 多 AI 编程工具，一个 Agent 隔离实现，另一个独立模型只读评审，交付补丁、测试收据和评审证据。支持 Claude Code、OpenCode、MCP，MIT 开源。

nodes.title: generalbots/generalbots
nodes.description: Multi-agent AI platform for autonomous agents, agentic AI orchestration and LLM workflow automation. 80 self-hosted apps - Chat, CRM, Mail, Drive, Calendar, Advanced RAG. Open source, built in Rust.

nodes.title: langgenius/dify
nodes.description: Build Agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, with rich AI model and tool support on one collaborative workspace. Deploy on cloud, VPC, or self-hosted, so teams move from prototype to production without rebuilding the stack.

nodes.description: AI-powered agents for Oddmash projects

nodes.title: phamTuan207/computer-use-wayland
nodes.description: GUI automation for AI agents on Wayland/Hyprland, built first for Muse agents: virtual pointer, keyboard, screen capture, Chromium DOM and native accessibility. One vision, maximum actions.

nodes.title: uvais8958/AgenticAI
nodes.description: Learning and exploring Agentic AI, including AI Agents, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, and building intelligent AI-powered applications using JavaScript and MERN Stack.

nodes.description: A coding agent: give it a prompt and it reads, writes, runs commands, and searches code in a loop until the work is done, using native tool-calling across OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google models.

nodes.title: AetherRavyn/RAVENBOT
nodes.description: Local-first multi-agent desktop workspace: persistent AI agents, offices, sandboxed tools, memory, MCP, and a headless daemon. Rust + Tauri + Svelte.

nodes.title: senoldogann/Dot
nodes.description: Dot: an autonomous agent that lives on your Mac. It works your browser, desktop, files, shell and MCP tools behind a safety gate you can read, remembers and learns skills, runs on a schedule, and comes with a native iPhone app. Local-first, MIT.

nodes.title: mathisarends/browserrig
nodes.description: Event-driven Chrome automation for AI agents and Python apps. Built on Harnessed, cdpify, and Pydantic.

nodes.title: vercel-labs/agent-browser
nodes.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents

nodes.title: skyfireitdiy/Jarvis
nodes.description: A multi-agent collaboration framework that lets AI agents work together, operate your computer, and browse the web.

nodes.title: Tencent/BrowserSkill
nodes.description: Let AI agents use your real, logged-in browser without interrupting your work. CLI + extension for browser automation across any shell-capable AI agent.

nodes.title: meharajM/ai-worker.app
nodes.description: Open-source desktop AI workspace for MCP tools, local files, browser automation, and provider-agnostic LLM workflows.

nodes.title: Ward-Software-Defined-Systems/embraOS
nodes.description: A continuity-preserving operating system for one AI, written in Rust — not a chatbot, not an agent framework. An immutable image, an identity sealed at first boot and verified by SHA-256 on every boot, memory that persists in a knowledge graph. Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama or LM Studio; QEMU and hypervisors on x86_64 and aarch64, and bare metal.

nodes.title: caura-ai/caura
nodes.description: Caura (formerly MemClaw) — governed shared memory for AI agent fleets. Multi-agent, multi-tenant, MCP-native. Trust tiers, keystone policies, audit trails, knowledge graph, self-improving retrieval. Apache 2.0.

nodes.title: doobidoo/mcp-memory-service
nodes.description: Open-source persistent memory for AI agent pipelines (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) and Claude. REST API + knowledge graph + autonomous consolidation.

nodes.title: vbcherepanov/total-agent-memory
nodes.description: Persistent local memory for AI coding agents — Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, any MCP client. Temporal knowledge graph, procedural memory, AST codebase ingest, cross-project analogy. LongMemEval R@5 95.1%, LoCoMo 0.607, BEAM 1M 0.448. 74 MCP tools, 9 IDEs, 100% local.

nodes.title: RoboFinSystems/robosystems-app
nodes.description: Part of RoboSystems, the open-source knowledge graph for finance. Its web app: graphs, MCP connections, Cypher, documents, subgraphs, memory and the SEC repository. Next.js, deployable to your own AWS account.

nodes.title: TonyIsFool/TidyPanel
nodes.description: Local CSV and Excel data cleaning for AI agents. R package + JSON CLI: 0 model calls and 0 AI inference tokens for cleanup. Keep full tables local; use model context for reasoning.

nodes.title: opentail-net/OpenTail.Stingray
nodes.description: Local AI, native to .NET. Run language models, vision, speech, and generative AI directly in your C# applications. No Python. No external inference server. CPU or GPU. Open source, built for NativeAOT.

nodes.title: tetherto/qvac
nodes.description: Open-source local AI SDK - run AI on-device with no cloud, no API keys. Supports GGUF, RAG, image, music, and video generation, speech-to-text, P2P inference, and more. Cross-platform: Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, iOS.

nodes.title: NeelM0906/Mference
nodes.description: Private AI that runs entirely on your Mac: a native SwiftUI app on its own Swift + Metal inference engine. Streams MoE experts from SSD (Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B in ~1.5 GB), runs GGUF through in-process llama.cpp, and serves an OpenAI-compatible local API.

nodes.title: Comfy-Org/ComfyUI
nodes.description: The most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, api and backend with a graph/nodes interface. The fastest local inference engine in the world.
